conventions.convention: Matrices and arithmetic are real and exact; A_h is SPD, P has full column rank with 1 ≤ m ≤ n, A_H=PᵀA_hP, and C=I−PA_H⁻¹PᵀA_h is the remaining-error map.
The energy adjoint is S* = A_h⁻¹SᵀA_h, and the symmetric two-grid error map is E=S*CS, with the adjoint post-smoother applied last.
The Poisson hierarchy has even N=2M≥4, h=1/N, stiffness scaling 1/h, zero endpoint coordinates, interpolation from even fine indices, and S=I−A_h/λ_max(A_h); ν is a positive integer.
H¹₀ is the Sobolev-norm closure of compactly supported smooth functions. Countable Choice is assumed for the Sobolev interfaces; membership is proved without invoking a trace characterization.

Cycle levels run from exact-solve level 0 upward. Each nonbase call initializes its coarse correction at zero and performs γ recursive calls using the current coarse iterate and a fixed restricted residual; γ=1 is V and γ=2 is W.

Aggregation uses nonpositive off-diagonal entries, 0<θ<1, least-unassigned-vertex aggregate selection, and a finite real cap L≥0. Its three output statuses certify setup termination, without certifying convergence.

load_bearing.statement: For real SPD A_h and full-column-rank P, A_H=PᵀA_hP is SPD and invertible. C=I−PA_H⁻¹PᵀA_h satisfies C²=C, CP=0, PᵀA_hC=0, and CᵀA_h=A_hC; its range is Ran(P) perpendicular in the A_h inner product.

For the stated even-grid 1D Dirichlet Poisson stiffness matrix, piecewise-linear prolongation, exact Galerkin correction C, and S=I−A_h/λ_max(A_h), every integer ν≥1 and fine vector e satisfy ‖CS^νe‖²_A_h ≤ 2/(2ν+1) ‖e‖²_A_h. The proved component bounds are ‖Cw‖²_A_h ≤ (h/2)‖A_hw‖²₂ and ‖A_hS^νe‖²₂ ≤ 4/[h(2ν+1)] ‖e‖²_A_h.
For E=S*CS as defined, if 0≤ρ<1 and ‖CSx‖²_A_h ≤ ρ‖x‖²_A_h for every fine vector x, then E is energy-self-adjoint and nonnegative and ‖E‖_A_h≤ρ.

On a finite SPD Galerkin hierarchy with full-column-rank prolongations, finite nonnegative pre/post sweep counts, fixed smoothing matrices, and positive integer γ, Cycle solves exactly at level 0; otherwise it pre-smooths, restricts the residual, makes γ recursive coarse-correction calls starting from zero, prolongs the correction, and post-smooths.

Every invocation on an admissible finite hierarchy terminates. For fixed q=2^d with integer d≥1, level sizes N_j=q^j, fixed positive per-level work cN_j, bounded positive base cost, and fixed positive integer γ, T(N)=cN+γT(N/q) has order Θ(N), Θ(N log N), or Θ(N^(log_q γ)) according as γ<q, γ=q, or γ>q.

Assume Countable Choice. Every continuous real function on [0,1] that is affine on each interval of a finite partition and vanishes at both endpoints has its Sobolev class in H¹₀(0,1), defined as the W¹,² closure of C_c^∞(0,1).
